description: 1→5 complete MAX-tank watering applications for 1→4→9→16→25 whole-bed harvests; simplified three-hour economy scenarios

assumptions.spawns: uses src/run-rules.js spawnInterval exactly; one spawn opportunity per cooldown, bounded by active cap only approximately
assumptions.kills: per spawned enemy approximate kill probability clamp(0.36+0.012*nominalDps/sqrt(enemyEndurance) - t/216000,0.2,0.9) × policy multiplier; enemyEndurance=1+min(1.5,max(0,t-600)/7200)
assumptions.drops: Water/heart based on run-rules weights; water collection assumed instantaneous until tank MAX, excess drops cannot be stored
assumptions.watering: Attention windows permit a single discrete action whenever the tank is full (100); each action empties the whole reservoir and increments one independent bed's watering count; requires side length 1–5 actions to bloom; simulated bed selection assumes free access
assumptions.attacks: simplified pressure estimate; actual enemy motion/hit/collision requires browser play verification
assumptions.upgrades: Prioritize expansion with early boomerang/balloon; model does not retune flower prices after changing watering to MAX charges
